Definition: Kirjath-Sannah or Kirjath-Sepher, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Caleb goes up to Debir, whose name before was Kirjath-sepher, and offers his daughter Achsah to the man who smites it. Othniel takes it, and the city keeps both its names in the record.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Caleb's offer still stands: the man who takes the city wins the daughter, and Othniel took it.
